scope: Original guest crun selected lifecycle, private PID/mount/UTS and proc mount; cgroupfs manager with freezer and subtree kill. Not full OCI conformance.

args: test "$$" = 1; read host < /proc/sys/kernel/hostname; test "$host" = container; test -r /proc/1/status; echo CONTAINER_PAYLOAD; exit 7
trap "echo TERM_RECEIVED > /terminated; exit 0" TERM; echo RUNNING > /ready; read line < /tmp/stop
test "$$" = 1; read host < /proc/sys/kernel/hostname; echo "$host" > /ready; echo shm > /dev/shm/marker; trap "echo TERM_RECEIVED > /terminated; exit 0" TERM; read line < /tmp/stop
test "$$" = 1; read host < /proc/sys/kernel/hostname; echo "$host" > /ready; echo shm > /dev/shm/marker; trap "echo TERM_RECEIVED > /terminated; exit 0" TERM; read line < /tmp/stop
test -t 0; test -t 1; test -t 2; test "$$" = 1; test "$(/bin/busybox readlink /proc/self/fd/0)" = /dev/pts/0; test "$(/bin/busybox stty size)" = "31 97"; echo CONTAINER_TERMINAL_PASS; exit 7
